items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Well I’m going to tell you this story about Buddy Rich. You know everyone in the world knows Buddy.

ctx.x: Well I’m going to tell you this story about Buddy Rich. You know everyone in the world knows Buddy. And unfortunately he had a brain tumor and he was being prepared to go into surgery. And he was probably sedated, and he was on the gurney and the nurse was about to give him a shot or something, whatever, before going into surgery. And she said, “Mr. Rich, are you allergic to anything?” And he kind of dazed open his eyes and said, “Yeah. Country-Western music.” Now that ought to give you an idea of that man’s wit.…
That’s not a hat you’re going to put on someday soon. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
